messages:
Amy Chen: Quick sync — Emergence customer story is ready for final steps. Interview recording in Drive, draft quotes below. Target publish Mon 04/05. Who can own quote sign-off + legal review?
Jordan Patel: I can own approvals. Need transcript + raw audio trimmed. Customer is CET so time windows matter. @Sophia Lee can you confirm editing ETA?
Sophia Lee: I can edit. Need raw audio + short transcript by Wed EOD to do hero cut + clips. Also legal asked for PII/redaction check.
Amy Chen: Draft hero quote (from interview):
```\"Redwood cut our inference latency in half while keeping outputs consistent — it let us ship a feature two quarters earlier.\"```
Jordan Patel: Good quote. I'll send to Emergence for sign-off. Also note: webinar slot request — customer ok to speak for 10 mins on Apr 12. Can we coordinate?
Sophia Lee: Editor schedule — I have a 4hr slot Thu. Will produce: hero 15s clip, 30s social, full 90s clip, and transcript.
LegalBot: New legal review requested: case-study language + benchmark claims. Upload release form when ready.
Oliver Grant: Reviewed draft quote. Suggest wording tweak: avoid "cut" -> use "reduced" or "improved'. Also need signed release form with explicit permission to publish benchmark numbers. Please send DocuSign.
Jordan Patel: Will send DocuSign today. Also need to confirm benchmark numbers for the narrative: engineering reported 2.3x latency improvement at 2k tokens and ~30% lower cost per token on the production workload. @Amy confirm copy accuracy?
Amy Chen: Confirmed those are the numbers engineering gave. For marketing copy we should phrase as: "approximately 30% lower cost per token" and cite internal report. Customer asked to preview the final landing page before publish.
Oliver Grant: Legal suggests exact phrasing: "approximately 30% lower cost per token" and cite report ID BR-2026-014. Also recommend removing comparative language that implies competitor names. Once DocuSign is returned and release uploaded, legal sign-off is clear.
Jordan Patel: Routing note — inbound leads from the case study should be tagged to SEs -> 'account-expansion' and routed to the assigned AE + playbook. I'll set the HubSpot form to do that.
Sophia Lee: Editor note: hero needs one-sentence quote only. Full quote to live in the body. I'll also provide two cut clips for webinar promo (30s and 90s).
Amy Chen: Asset checklist updated in the doc: hero quote, long quote, hero image, 3 social cards, embed player, lead form with UTM. Set embargo: Emergence requested embargo until Mon 04/05 09:00 ET. Marked in calendar.
Jordan Patel: DocuSign sent (just now). I'll update thread when signed. Also drafting the landing page copy with the benchmark callout and methodology blurb.
Oliver Grant: DocuSign completed and release uploaded to legal repo: https://legal.redwood.internal/releases/emergence/RELEASE_1772347240.pdf. Legal approves the copy change; confirmed permission to publish benchmark numbers with citation.
Amy Chen: Great — Sophia, you can proceed with cuts. Jordan, update the publish checklist and I'll coordinate launch comms (tweet + blog + webinar invite).
Sophia Lee: Starting edits. Will post assets here when ready. ETA: Fri 04/02 EOD for final exports.
Jordan Patel: I'll queue the webinar invite and add Emergence speaker to Apr 12 slot (10:00 PT / 18:00 CET). Also set the landing form routing and UTM.
Amy Chen: Thanks all — will do a final pass on Monday AM 04/05 08:00 ET, then hit publish at 09:00 ET embargo. :rocket: 
Jordan Patel: Noted. Will post final signed release and link to landing draft here when done.
Oliver Grant: Approved from legal. All clear to publish after embargo + final customer preview.
Jordan Patel: Final: release signed at 1772347240, landing draft url: https://redwood.in/internal-drafts/emergence-case-2026. Will update with final page link after publish.
